A '''plasti-shroud''' was a covering used to conceal [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. [[Tay Vanis]] used a plasti-shroud to hide his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] on [[Questal/Legends|Questal]].<ref name="GC">''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''</ref>
